description.value: Bolacco Caffé is a family-owned espresso bar and café in Sun Peaks village that has been operating since 1996. It bakes its pastries in-house throughout the day and offers a full sandwich menu alongside a wide range of hot and cold coffee drinks. Situated at the heart of a popular four-season mountain resort, it is a natural gathering point for cyclists riding in the Sun Peaks area.

address.value: 3160 Creekside Way, Suite #109, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and corroborates OSM tags on name, address (3160 Creekside Way Suite #109, Sun Peaks, BC), phone, and hours. The menu page confirms takeout-style Grab & Go Items and an explicit Veggie Sandwich plus plant-based milk alternatives, supporting vegetarian/vegan claims. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging, or water refill anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating café in Sun Peaks village with a confirmed website and consistent contact details; a natural stop for touring cyclists in the Thompson/Okanagan region.
